Package index

Fitting

Estimate the EVZINB / EVINB model and tune the EM algorithm.

evzinb()
Running an extreme value and zero inflated negative binomial model with bootstrapping
evinb()
Running an extreme value inflated negative binomial model with bootstrapping
evinf_control()
Control settings for evzinb() / evinb()
add_bootstraps()
Add more bootstrap replicates to a fitted model
failed_bootstraps()
Inspect the bootstrap replicates that failed or came out degenerate

Summaries and tables

Inspect a fitted model and build regression tables.

summary(<evzinb>)
EVZINB summary function
print(<evzinb>)
EVZINB print function
tidy(<evzinb>)
EVZINB tidy function
glance(<evzinb>)
EVZINB and EVINB glance functions
coefficient_extractor()
Bootstrap coefficient extractor
gof_map_evinf()
Goodness-of-fit map for modelsummary
gm_evzinb
A goodness-of-fit gof tibble for GOF metrics when using modelsummary

Prediction and effects

Predicted quantities, prediction grids and marginal effects.

predict(<evzinb>)
Predictions from evzinb object
predict_grid()
Build a prediction grid and evaluate a model over it
marginal_effects()
Average marginal effects for an evzinb / evinb model

Diagnostics and plots

Threshold diagnostics, state classification and plot methods.

plot(<evzinb>) plot(<evinb>)
Plots for evzinb / evinb models
c_profile()
Log-likelihood profile over the candidate values of C_EV
plot_c_profile()
Plot the log-likelihood profile over the candidate values of C_EV
classify_states()
Prior and posterior state classification
state_table()
Cross-tabulate prior vs posterior state classification

Model comparison

Compare against negative-binomial and ZINB alternatives.

compare_models()
Function to compare evzinb or evinb models with zinb and nb models
compare_fit() plot(<evzinbcomp>)
Compare the extreme-value model against its plainer counterparts
lr_test()
Likelihood ratio test for individual variables of evzinb
oob_evaluation()
Out of bag predictive performance of EVZINB and EVINB models
tidy(<evzinbcomp>) glance(<evzinbcomp>)
Stacked tidy / glance for a model comparison

Estimation internals

The EM / ECME driver behind evzinb() and evinb(). Not exported; documented for readers of the algorithm.

em_fit()
EM / ECME driver for the EVZINB and EVINB models
em_fit_fixed_c()
EM iterations for the EVZINB / EVINB mixture at a fixed \(C_{EV}\)
em_step()
One EM step for the EVZINB / EVINB mixture at fixed \(C_{EV}\)
em_profile_c()
Profile the log-likelihood over the extreme-value threshold
em_c_candidates()
Candidate set for the extreme-value threshold \(C_{EV}\)
em_extend_design()
Prepend the intercept column to each component design matrix
em_fitted_values()
Fitted quantities from a fitted EVZINB / EVINB parameter set
